findings.reason: Both authentic original standalone tiles contain instructions and instrument justification but no circuit. A register-level circuit materially clarifies the reversed control-power index, positive-sign inverse QFT, and coherent-prefix boundary. This is an explanatory addition under the expanded diagram criterion, not a claim of a faulty procedure.
findings.action: Added a bundled phase/system circuit and exact definition of its controlled-power block in existing final Remarks; retained all original text.

correction: Added a general-m register-level QPE circuit showing Hadamards, controlled block D, inverse positive-sign QFT, coherent-prefix cut and phase measurement; documented exact wire-power assignment and nonzero-branch system output.

diagram_math_checks.objects: P=(C^2)^{tensor m} and finite-dimensional H; phase bundle ordered q_0,...,q_{m-1}; input |0^m> tensor psi.
diagram_math_checks.check: The upper H^{tensor m} acts P to P and all subsequent phase gates act P to P; D acts P tensor H to itself. Each supplied controlled gate is C^2 tensor H to itself with control first, as def-qc-controlled-unitary-access specifies. Bundling avoids implying extra wires at m=1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition input and steps 1-3; def-qa-eigenphase-estimation-model; def-qc-ordered-bitstring-encoding; def-qc-controlled-unitary-access.

diagram_math_checks.check: For chronological j=0,...,m-1 use control q_{m-1-j} and target U^{2^j}. On |x> tensor v the exponent is sum_j b_{m-1-j}2^j=x, hence D(|x> tensor v)=|x> tensor U^x v. The diagram annotation retains this assignment rather than reversing the big-endian bundle.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 3 and the exact weight assignment in def-qa-eigenphase-estimation-model, whose bitstring index is defined by def-qc-ordered-bitstring-encoding.

diagram_math_checks.check: The positive-sign QFT has entry Q^{-1/2} exp(2 pi i xy/Q); its inverse has negative sign. After D on eigenvector input the phase amplitudes are Q^{-1/2} exp(2 pi i x theta); applying the inverse therefore compares theta with y/Q with the correct sign. The inverse-QFT box does not apply U^{-1}.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 4 and following original caveat; def-qa-cyclic-quantum-fourier-transform explicitly defines positive sign.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Dashed prefix boundary, M measurement, outputs y,y/Q and psi.
diagram_math_checks.check: Boundary is after QFT inverse and before M. M touches only P and has the original projectors |y><y| tensor I_H. Because U^x psi=exp(2 pi i x theta)psi, the state is a tensor product before M, and every nonzero-probability conditioned branch keeps system state psi (up to irrelevant global phase). No exact m-bit phase promise is implied by the output.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Original step 5 and original instrument argument in Remarks; eigenvector promise in def-qa-eigenphase-estimation-model. All original procedure and instrument justification remain independent of the figure.

original_evidence.path_discrepancy: Recorded evidence_dir/inspection_dir places screenshots under diagram-supplement, but files are absent there. Authentic files were located within the same quantum-algorithms category and verified against both recorded SHA256 values.
